title: London System: the ideas
line: The bishop comes out early, then pawns build a solid triangle behind it.

steps.text: Push the pawn in front of your queen two squares. It takes the center and frees your bishop.

also.e2e4: That is the most played first move, the king pawn opening. This lesson plays the queen pawn.
also.c2c4: That is the English Opening, also sound. This lesson plays the queen pawn.
also.g1f3: That is the knight first, often a Réti Opening. This lesson plays the queen pawn.

steps.text: Bring the knight out. It guards the center square e5.

also.c2c4: That is the Queen's Gambit, another sound opening. This lesson builds the London System.

steps.text: Bring the bishop out now, before you move the king pawn. Then the pawn does not shut it in.

also.c2c4: That is the Queen's Gambit, also sound. This lesson builds the London System.
also.e2e3: That is the Colle System, also sound. This lesson brings the bishop out first.
also.c1g5: That is the Torre Attack, also sound. This lesson puts the bishop on another square.

steps.text: Move the pawn in front of your king one square. It guards your center pawn and frees the other bishop.
Move the pawn on c2 one square. Pawns on c3, d4 and e3 make a solid triangle.
The knight goes to d2. When Black offers to trade bishops, yours steps back to g3. The other bishop comes to d3.
Here Black brought the queen out to attack the pawn on b2, a sound main line. The mistake comes if the queen takes it.
Bring the knight out and let the queen take the pawn on b2.

also.d4c5: Taking on c5 is sound too. This lesson lets the queen take the bait.

steps.after: Black took the bait. Its queen is far from home.

steps.text: Jump the knight to b5. It threatens to jump to c7 and fork the king and the rook.
steps.hint: Look for a knight jump that threatens the square c7.
steps.after: Black has to cover c7. Then your rook can come to b1 and chase the queen.

summary: The bishop comes out before the king pawn, then pawns build a triangle. A queen that grabs the side pawn gets chased.
